description: This easy waterside walk takes you along the Monmouthshire and Brecon Canal from Abergavenny to Crickhowell and Brecon. You can start your walk in the town centre and then head south to Llanfoist crossing the River Usk on the way. In Llanfoist you pick up the canal towpath and follow it west to neighbouring Govilon. The route continues west to Gilwern, Crickhowell and Talybont on Usk before finishing in Brecon. Most of the route is suitable for cyclists. Along the way you will enjoy some fine views of the surrounding countryside and hills.
